name: UML Class Diagram
description: Generate PlantUML UML diagrams for class structures and relationships
helpContent: Create PlantUML UML diagrams showing classes, interfaces, inheritance, and associations.
template:
Generate a PlantUML UML diagram showing:
1. Classes and their attributes
2. Methods and visibility
3. Inheritance relationships
4. Associations and dependencies
5. Interfaces and implementations

Use standard UML notation.

name: Deployment Diagram
description: PlantUML deployment diagram showing infrastructure and node relationships
helpContent: Design deployment diagrams in PlantUML showing how components are deployed across nodes/servers.
template:
Create a PlantUML deployment diagram showing:
1. Deployment nodes (servers, containers)
2. Artifacts deployed on each node
3. Connections between nodes
4. Network/communication links
5. Important configurations

Show the actual infrastructure layout.
